Quick internal calculations attached (finite_analysis.xlsx). Key assumptions:

- Workload: 120 prompt tokens + 400 completion tokens, 250k monthly completions.
- Baseline: host model at fp16 with default batching (latency p50 85ms, p95 280ms).
- 8-bit (dynamic) reduces compute time per token ~40% on A100-like GPU; estimated cost reduction (compute line) = 38%.
- Cache effect: if Fintechio reuses >35% of tokens via prefix cache, total monthly token billing exposure drops ~20-35% depending on overlap.

Pricing recommendations (for the proposal):
- Tiered discounts tied to committed monthly token throughput (3-tier):
  1) 250k–1M completions: 8% discount on per-token rate + free cache tier (up to 100GB prefix cache)
  2) 1M–5M completions: 15% discount + recommended 8-bit profile tested on a canary with rollback window
  3) >5M completions: 22% discount + co-engineering support to tune batching/cache policies

- One-time onboarding credit to offset evaluation costs (applies to tier 2+).

Notes: the discount model pairs discounts with measurable configuration changes (e.g., enabling 8-bit quantization or enabling persistent cache) so the unit economics remain aligned.

Attachments: finite_analysis.xlsx (cost model), see also redwood_savings_model_v2.pdf for the customer one-pager.
